definitions.gloss: an iron pot or pan — cookware made of cast iron or wrought iron, valued for even heat retention and durability
definitions.explanation: Refers to any cooking pot or pan made of iron. Often used in Japanese cooking for dishes that benefit from high heat or long simmering, such as すき{焼|や}き or {餃子|ぎょうざ}. Also commonly seen at restaurants as a serving vessel that keeps food hot at the table.

examples.japanese: {鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cook in an iron pan.

examples.japanese: {鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{譲|ゆず}り{受|う}けた→譲り受ける：27545_yuzuriukeru⟧{鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I still use the iron pot I inherited from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱々|あつあつ}→熱々：20109_atsuatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鉄鍋|てつなべ}ごと⟦{運|はこ}ばれて→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧くる。
examples.english: At this restaurant, the gyoza are brought out sizzling hot in the iron pan itself.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ ("iron") + ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ ("pot, pan"). Refers to cookware made of iron — including skillets, Dutch-oven-style pots, and the Chinese-style shallow pans used for ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧.

USAGE:
- The same object can also be called a ⟦{鉄製|てつせい}→鉄製：25875_tetsusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ ("iron-made pot") in more formal writing.
- At restaurants, the phrase {鉄鍋|てつなべ}ごと means "pan and all" — the dish is served in the hot pan itself.
- Iron pans require seasoning and careful maintenance; this is often discussed with the verb ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ ("to raise/season") or ⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ("to maintain").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to cook (sear, fry) in an iron pan
- {鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: iron-pan cuisine
- {鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧: gyoza served in an iron pan
- {鉄鍋|てつなべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to season/break in an iron pan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: general word for pot or pan — any material.
- ⟦{土鍋|どなべ}→土鍋：07949_donabe⟧: earthenware pot — used for hot pot dishes like ⟦{鍋物|なべもの}→鍋物：14804_nabemono⟧.
- ⟦{中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}→中華鍋：24172_chuukanabe⟧: wok — a Chinese-style iron pan.
- ⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧: frying pan — usually implies a modern pan with a handle, often non-stick.
